title: ql_deliver.held() treats a failed for-each-ref, merge-base or diff as nothing held
goal: ql_deliver.held() raises (so nothing is pushed) when git for-each-ref, merge-base or diff --name-only fails, as it already does for an unreadable file; a test fails each call in turn and asserts the push is held. From the SP-z7a5c76b review (TK-ubcrwu7t).
